title: Matter manifest (HELM-MATTER-BUILD-SPEC.md §2)
description: Helm-local container binding one engagement (exam/filing/dispute/onboarding) — NOT an OCG chaingraph artifact, not submitted to SPEC.md. Lives in helmd's SQLite store, exported as JSON. Binds EXISTING helmd runs/evidence-bundles/approval-records by hash, never a payload copy (§3). manifest_digest is a JCS (cgCanon) digest of the manifest with manifest_digest itself omitted from the preimage, computed via the vendored hub/vendored/ocg/kernels/_hash.mjs canon path (HELM-PHASE1-BUILD-SPEC D3 kernel-parity vendoring) — not a second hashing scheme.

matter_id.description: Helm-local opaque ULID. Never derived from or colliding with any execution_hash.

entity.description: The reporting entity this matter concerns — reuses the §9 identity shape already normative for OCG identities (openchain-graph-v0.4.schema.json $defs.humanAccountabilityRecord.properties.identity). No new identity vocabulary.

role.description: OPEN free text ("examiner", "counsel", "client contact") — NOT the §27.1 closed accountability-role vocabulary. Where a party is also a §27 preparer/reviewer/approver on a bound artifact, that role binding lives on the §27 record itself, referenced via bindings[], never duplicated here.

done_at.description: OPTIONAL. done:true records are append-only — never delete, never flip back to false.

subject_hash.description: References an EXISTING artifact only — never a payload copy. Same discipline as §27.2 subject_hash.

subject_kind.description: external_reference is the ONLY kind that may point at content Helm never verified; every rendering MUST label it distinctly, never collapsed into "verified" (§26.6 trust-label discipline).

narrative.description: OPTIONAL free text for matter-level context not belonging to any one bound artifact. NOT a place to restate findings/decisions already existing as §27 records — those stay referenced via bindings[].

items.description: A SALI LMSS ontology IRI (rdf:about), e.g. http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mpgb1WQXzd7cnaiMK0dig — pinned shape: research/clause-snapshots/SALI-LMSS.citations.md, "Namespace / IRI shape". The pinned snapshot's own dc:identifier short codes (e.g. ASI-TH-TH+24) are explicitly NOT valid values here — SALI's internal display code, not the stable identifier.

lmss_tags.description: OPTIONAL, amendment 2026-08-20 (§2). Open vocabulary within LMSS — zero or more IRIs per matter, no local matter-type taxonomy invented. Absent on every matter created before this amendment; an empty or missing array is equivalent and remains valid.

manifest_digest.description: JCS digest (cgCanon, vendored _hash.mjs) of this manifest's own content with manifest_digest itself excluded from the preimage. NOT a hash-preimage member of any OCG execution_hash.
